title: Manchester City: what the result story really means
body:
BBC Sport has a result story involving Manchester City [S1]. The headline said it plainly: “The part-timers who won three Wembley finals in a row” [S1]. The names in the frame: Pep Guardiola's Manchester City [S1].

One detail from the report stands out: “Guardiola's Manchester City won four League Cups on the” [S1]. In our Football-Data.co.uk results, Manchester City have 2 wins, 0 draws and 3 defeats from their last 5 league games: 6 points, 8 scored and 8 conceded [ST1].

It was the kind of game that tells you more about character than about tactics. Results like this shape a season far more than any press conference ever will. The Touchline Take: enjoy it, but the real test is backing it up next week.

evidence.text: BBC Sport: The part-timers who won three Wembley finals in a row. You probably knew Pep Guardiola's Manchester City won four League Cups on the bounce between 2018 and 2021 – but another side did the silverware hat-trick first.
Manchester City last 5 league matches in Football-Data.co.uk results: 2 wins, 0 draws, 3 defeats, 6 points, 8 goals scored, 8 conceded (sequence WWLLL).
